entities.summary: Gløshaug Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Grong Municipality in Trøndelag county, Norway. It is located in the village of Gartland. It is one of the two churches for the Harran parish which is part of the Namdal prosti (deanery) in the Diocese of Nidaros. The red, wooden stave church was built in a long church style in 1689. The church seats about 100 people.
